what_happened: Original review's per-file keymap-desc-missing breakdown (44 total) did not match verified codebase state: actual missing count is 41 repo-wide (40 after excluding a config/keymaps.lua false positive where desc is threaded via a helper's description parameter). features.lua was undercounted (11 vs 10), util/notifications.lua was undercounted (8 vs 4), templates.lua was overcounted (2 vs 4), and autopairs.lua's one call already has desc (review said 1 missing).

Research report shipped a verified per-call, per-line desc inventory with suggested wording for all 40 defects, so planning needed only a single confirming re-derivation scan instead of re-inventorying 11 files; also pre-corrected the task description's wrong count (44) and two wrong per-file breakdowns.

Phase 4's verify-deploy.sh run reported 3 of 35 checks failing (doc-lint, run-all.sh shell test suite, whole-tree orphan detection); all three traced to concurrent sibling dispatch activity and pre-existing dirty working-tree state outside this task's lua/neotex/** scope (a sibling run-all.sh invocation was observed running concurrently; books extension docs were already dirty at session start; both named orphan files carry session-scratch UUIDs). Closed Phase 4 as COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS with a full Reasoned Exclusions record rather than blocking on these out-of-scope failures.
